sekem_formula.description: At Tel Aviv University, the Sekem score is calculated by combining the weighted Bagrut average (after bonuses) and the Psychometric score. The weighting is typically 50/50 but can vary by faculty. The Psychometric score is normalized to a 0-100 scale (or university specific scale) before combination. Bonuses are given for 5-unit subjects: Math (25 pts), English (20 pts), Physics (20 pts), and others (20 pts).
